confirm.replaceAssetBody_other: This figure has {{count}} edits; swapping the asset clears them (undoable). Position, size, crop and stacking order are kept.

confirm.resetOverridesBody_other: This figure returns to what the source script currently generates. {{count}} edits are cleared (undoable). The script and original file are unchanged.
